title: Field-coverage drift heatmap and config-aware sensitivity probes for structured outputs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: We currently detect structured-output regressions primarily via aggregate contract checks and per-field deltas triggered after rollouts. This misses localized failures where a small subset of fields go from reliable to flaky only under specific model/config combinations (e.g., temperature changes, quantization variant).

Goal: Build a lightweight, roll-forward friendly 'field-coverage heatmap' and an associated suite of 'config-aware sensitivity probes' that: (1) correlate per-field pass/fail rates with model/config axes, (2) surface fields with brittle behavior in a visual heatmap across recent rollouts, and (3) produce ranked test-probes to quickly reproduce and guard the failure path in CI/canary.

Scope: Engineering proof-of-concept for hosted inference (API traffic + shadow evals) with integration points for Dedicated/Private in follow-up iterations. Deliverables: heatmap service, probe generator CLI, dashboard widgets in Console, canary alert rules.

Out-of-scope: full synthetic dataset generation for every model family (we'll reuse existing eval templates) and full RBAC dashboard controls (deferred to Console team).

Acceptance criteria:
- Heatmap server aggregates per-field boolean pass/fail for structured outputs into a time-windowed matrix keyed by (field, model-version, config-tag).
- Correlation view that highlights top-10 fields whose pass rates vary >=15 percentage points across config axis (e.g., temperature, sampling strategy, quant level).
- Automated probe generator outputs a minimized set of 10-50 prompts that reproduce a failing field under target config and a compatible 'control' config.
- Canary integration: when a rollout changes model or config, the heatmap pipeline runs and triggers an alert if any field moves from >95% to <80% within 48 hours. Alerts must include the probe set and a suggested rollback flag.
- Dashboard: an embeddable widget in Console showing the heatmap for the last 7 days with filters by customer cohort and route.

Implementation plan:
1) Data surface: extend structured-output telemetry (ENG-16358) to emit per-response binary pass/fail per field and annotate with config metadata (model_id, model_version, quantization, temp, sampler). Storage format will be existing timeseries + parquet snapshots for analysis.
2) Heatmap aggregator: service that consumes parquet snapshots and computes matrix indexed by (field, config_bucket). We'll use bloom-filter backed counters for memory efficiency and approximate quantiles for delta detection.
3) Sensitivity probes: use weighted sample selection from recent failing responses + small search over prompt prefixes to find minimal reproducers. Probes packaged as runnable JSONL for CI/canary.
4) UI + Alerts: Console widgets and alert rules that link to probes, implicated rollout, and suggested fallback.

Metrics to monitor:
- Time-to-detect: latency from regression onset to alert (target < 2 hours for canary; < 48 hours for production).
- Precision of flagged fields: fraction of flagged fields that are actionable (target > 75%).
- Probe repro rate: fraction of generated probes that reproduce the failure (target > 60% in canary environments).

Risks & mitigations:
- Noise from low-volume routes: mitigate by sample-weighting and minimum volume thresholds.
- Probe flakiness due to nondeterministic models: tag probes with required config and sampling seeds where possible; fall back to control config comparisons.
- Storage cost: use time-windowed retention (7d heatmap, 30d snapshots) and sampling to limit footprint.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1 (Spike): instrument 3 routes with telemetry + prototype aggregator running on nightly snapshots.
- Week 2 (Canary): enable probe generation for a small set of model rollouts; validate UI.
- Week 3 (Production toggle): activate alerting for all hosted API rollouts; ship dashboard widget in Console as beta.
